Nivel de vechime: Asociat
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT
Who We Are
 We are looking for an experienced Full-Stack Engineer to join a client project and contribute to the design, development, and evolution of modern web applications. The successful candidate will have strong hands-on experience across both backend and frontend development, with a particular focus on Python, FastAPI, React, and TypeScript. The role involves working across the complete software development lifecycle, from technical design and implementation through testing, integration, deployment, and ongoing improvement.
 What You'll Be Doing
Design, develop, and maintain scalable full-stack web applications
Develop robust backend services and REST APIs using Python and FastAPI
Build modern, responsive, and reusable frontend components using React and TypeScript
Design and implement integrations between frontend applications, backend services, databases, and external systems
Work with relational databases including MariaDB and PostgreSQL
Design and optimize database schemas, queries, and data-access patterns
Ensure application performance, scalability, reliability, and maintainability
Implement appropriate error handling, logging, validation, and security controls
Write clean, maintainable, well-structured, and testable code
Develop and maintain automated unit and integration tests
Participate in code reviews and contribute to engineering standards and best practices
Troubleshoot application issues across frontend, backend, and database layers
Collaborate with product owners, architects, developers, QA engineers, DevOps engineers, and other stakeholders
Participate in Agile development activities such as refinement, planning, daily meetings, reviews, and retrospectives
Contribute to technical documentation and knowledge sharing within the team
 What You'll Bring Along
Strong hands-on experience with Python, FastAPI, and RESTful API development
Experience with MariaDB, PostgreSQL, SQL, and relational database design
Knowledge of data modeling, database integration, API validation, authentication, authorization, and exception handling
Strong hands-on experience with React, TypeScript, and JavaScript (ES6+)
Experience building component-based, responsive web applications
Proficiency in REST API integration, state management, and asynchronous data handling
Solid understanding of HTML5 and CSS3
Good understanding of object-oriented design, clean code principles, and software development best practices
Experience with Git, automated testing, unit and integration testing
Knowledge of API design, documentation, debugging, performance optimization, and secure development practices
Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines; experience with Docker and Kubernetes/cloud environments is a plus
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities
Effective communication and collaboration skills
Ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions
Proactive, quality-focused mindset with experience working in Agile/Scrum environments
